{{Quote|I've never seen a mine with such destructive power!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies">{{TCWComicCite|6.51|Deadly Allies}}</ref>}}
A '''land mine''' was an explosive device, concealed under or on the ground and designed to destroy or disable enemy targets as they passed over or near the device. 

==Description==
Land [[Mine/Legends|mines]] were widely used in [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground warfare]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Considered to be one of the most insidious weapons used in combat, land mines were basic explosive devices designed to be concealed until they were triggered. A variety of models were available, with the most [[Anti-personnel mine/Legends|common]] being designed to kill and maim [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] forces. Mines were typically triggered by physical pressure, such as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] stepping on it. [[Anti-vehicle mine/Legends|Vehicle mines]] could distinguish between infantry and ground craft, allowing it to be triggered only by the passing of vehicles. This led to tactics such as friendly troops luring enemy vehicles into active minefields.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Specific models included simple models such as [[Conner Ship Systems]]' [[3HX3 timer mine]], the [[variable-altitude repulsorlift mine]],<ref name="EGWT" /> and [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] versatile [[LX-4 proton mine/Legends|LX-4 proton mine]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

==History==
When [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] baited a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] out of its cave to get the [[Star Map]], it stepped on a land mine and was killed.
